title: Pinboard: Focus Micro-Contracts & Failure Modes — Maria Ikeda
content:
Purpose: quick, messy log for a 2-week output experiment. Trying to convert vague intentions into micro-contracts that I can actually check each day. Keep this informal — mostly notes to self and an experiment scaffold.

Context
- Problem: I get momentum at start of sprints but lose focus mid-week due to context switching and low-friction distractions (emails, lightweight PR reviews). Want stable, measurable daily outputs not just busywork.
- Hypothesis: If I set 3 micro-contracts per 2-week block and define failure modes + remediation, I will increase meaningful throughput (PRs merged that unblock others, docs shipped, evals run) by ~25%.

Micro-contracts (2-week sprint)
1) Deep PRs: Merge 2 PRs that unblock infra work.
   - What counts: PRs > 300 lines changed OR any change that removes a TODO in runtime.
   - Success metric: 2 merged back-to-back green builds by end of sprint.
2) Eval sprint: Run at least 1 targeted eval suite on model-rerank and produce a short findings note.
   - Success metric: eval run + write-up < 4 hours; at least one concrete action (tweak prompt, change batch config).
3) Knowledge share: 20-min demo + 1 pager on the approach I used for caching heuristic.
   - Success metric: demo scheduled and 1-pager in Confluence.

Daily ritual (check-in, 15m)
- Morning 5-min: pick top 1 micro-contract for the day (not all three).
- Midday 5-min: quick halfway check — did I make progress? If not, identify one blocker and one tiny action.
- End-of-day 5-min: record numeric output (LOC, evals run, PRs opened/closed, minutes of focused work).

Quick output tracking (use this as a very tiny log)
- Day 1 (Mon 2026-02-24): aimed at Deep PRs. 120m focused — wrote tests and addressed review comments. Opened PR #834.
- Day 2: 90m — finished second test file; PR updated. Blocker: intermittent CI flakiness (flaky GPU allocation). Raised JIRA-ENG-845.
- Day 3: 60m — switched to Eval sprint due to CI; ran baseline eval (20m) + collected token breakdown. Note: memory spike at seq_len=1024.

Failure modes (explicit)
- FM1: Small-thing drift — I spend morning on email/ops and never start the deeper work.
  - Trigger signals: inbox > 25 unread, >3 meetings before 11am.
  - Remediation: calendar focus block 9:00–11:00 on my calendar (mark tentative), enable "do not disturb" on Slack.
- FM2: Context-frag — I get pulled into reviews and lose the thread of my PR.
  - Trigger signals: >4 review pings, PR has >2 dependent comments unresolved.
  - Remediation: schedule a 30-min pairing session with reviewer; if unresolved past 48 hours, escalate to owner.
- FM3: Overnight regressions / eval flakiness cause wasted cycles.
  - Trigger signals: nightly eval fails intermittently (>2 failures in a row).
  - Remediation: add minimal deterministic seed to eval harness and log environment; isolate a repro.

Mini-retro template (use at end of sprint)
- Wins (quantified): what shipped, unblocked work, concrete numbers.
- Misses (concrete failure modes that triggered).
- Weird signals (unexpected outcomes).
- Next micro-contract adjustments (what to tighten/loosen).

Current sprint quick retro notes (scratch)
- Wins: Opened PR #834 (Deep PR) and scheduled demo. Baseline eval completed.
- Misses: CI flakiness cost ~3 dev hours; wasted debugging time because I didn't capture env before re-running.
- Weird: eval runtime was 40% longer on a different machine — may be kernel mismatch.
- Next: add quick env dump to eval harness; ask infra for pinned node for 2 hours for repro.

Open questions / to-dos
- Q1: Is PR #834 acceptable as a "unblock" by infra team? Quick ask Samir in 1:1.
- Q2: Who on infra can I ping to get a pinned node for repro? (Ping Evelyn)
- TODO: add deterministic seed + env dump to eval-runner (2h). Linked: JIRA-ENG-845.
- TODO: schedule 20-min demo (target week 2, Thu). Add to calendar and Confluence.

Notes to self (voice)
- Keep micro-contracts tight. If anything reads like a wish, rewrite as a contractable outcome + acceptance test.
- Logging small wins in the morning helps keep the momentum visible. Share tiny wins with team slack at EOD.

Scratch ideas for next sprint (carry-forward experiments)
- Micro-blocking assumption: try 45/15 focus cadence for 2 days and measure PR delta.
- Test batching change config on a small model to get earlier signal for token costs.

References / quick links
- Confluence draft: CONFLUENCE-1234 (caching heuristic notes)
- Jira: JIRA-ENG-845 (CI flakiness repro)
- Slack thread: slack://thread/CP1Q2R3S4 (review discussion on PR #834)

End note: this is deliberately low-fidelity. If something matters—turn it into an issue or a calendar event immediately. Otherwise treat it as a brain dump to prune next week.

---
Last quick metrics snapshot (end of Day 6)
- Focus minutes (sum): 540m
- PRs opened: 1 (834)
- PRs merged: 0
- Eval runs: 2 (baseline + stress)
- Docs started: 1 (demo 1-pager draft)

If I keep this cadence, target by sprint end: merge 1 PR, run 4 evals, demo scheduled + 1-pager published.
